data.body: PLANNING_CONSIDERATION (from preplanning Phase E adversarial review): The Done Definitions must explicitly enumerate all 6 integration sub-tests by name: (a) session-timeout query returns entry tagged auth/forms or containing "session timeout" in Summary; (b) --tier=summary output has ### Summary, no ### Implementation; (c) manifest integrity — every _index.yaml entry resolves to a file at its declared path; (d) no corpus file exceeds 500 lines; (e) precision sub-test — three representative queries each return a top result whose frontmatter tags match a predefined expected-tag mapping; (f) completes within 10 seconds. Also: reconcile with bdb4-3211 (federal-style-canon Foundation slice) — sub-test (e) precision query for USWDS form validation must pass after bdb4-3211 ships, so cfa6-6c7f integration test completion is a dependency of bdb4-3211.
